<thought>We need a valid template ID for the Peterson elimination that converts a β‑hydroxy‑silane to an alkene. Since the placeholder ID 123456 was not found, we will search the template catalog for reactions that break a Si‑C bond and an O‑C bond and form a C=C bond. This should return the appropriate template ID.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["trimethylsilyl", "alcohol"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["alkene"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C-Si", "C-O"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C=C"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
